title: JS ブロックコメント内の `*/` によるコメント早期終端 (SyntaxError)
signature: `SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier / Unexpected token` — エラー行はコメントの途中を指す
root_cause: `/* ... */` ブロックコメント内に `t2_*/m2_*` や `t1_*/catalog` のような
fix: ブロックコメント内では `t2_* / m2_*`(スペースを挟む)か `t2_ / m2_ prefixes` のような言い換えにする。`//` 行コメントなら安全 / 予防: このリポジトリの規約表記「`t2_*`/`m2_*`」をコメントへコピペする時が危険箇所

title: Kanflow logger takes (message, context), not pino-style (context, message)
signature: log.warn({ ... }, "message") / log.error({ ... }, "message"): pino-style argument order on the Kanflow logger
context: Kanflow v2 app: logging from a service with logger.child({ module }) (src/lib/logger)
root_cause: src/lib/logger has the signature log.warn(message: string, context?: object); writing the pino order log.warn({ ... }, "msg") passes an object as the message
fix: Call log.warn("what happened", { ruleId, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) }) - message first, context object second (see src/services/git/git-scope-check.ts)

title: Kanflow worktree: the first Edit of a file that differs from main is refused once (worktree-boundary OVERLAP) - re-apply it
signature: tsc error TS2561 / TS2305 / TS2353 right after parallel Edit calls in a worktree: a key, export or property added in one file is missing in another
context: Editing several files in parallel in a Kanflow v2 worktree (D:/APP/Kanflow-<name>) where pre:edit:worktree-boundary reports OVERLAP for files also changed on other branches
root_cause: pre:edit:worktree-boundary blocks the first edit of each overlapping file once per session; the parallel edits to the other files succeed, so the code no longer matches (e.g. an i18n key used but not declared)
fix: After any batch of Edit calls, scan the results for [worktree-boundary] OVERLAP errors and re-run exactly those edits (the overlap is intended for the v2 line) before typechecking

title: A timestamp taken before waiting for a lock collides with the previous holder (unique key on time)
signature: Unique constraint failed on the fields: ("projectId", "supersededAt") in concurrent finalizeActuals
context: Kanflow E1 finalizeActuals: two concurrent finalizations serialize on pg_advisory_xact_lock; each supersedes the previous snapshot with its own now
root_cause: now = new Date() was computed at function entry, before waiting for the advisory lock, so the waiting call could reuse the same millisecond as an earlier supersede
fix: Take the time AFTER acquiring the lock and make it strictly later than the latest stored time: now = max(Date.now(), max(supersededAt, finalizedAt) + 1 ms) (src/services/plan-actuals/actuals.service.ts)
